title: Dock reusable submodels through exposed endpoints
applicability: Use when attaching a reusable panel, roof, or accessory as a single unit. The moving module needs a free local endpoint and the placed parent needs a matching world endpoint.
steps: Define the submodel around a durable fitting. Name its leaves, mount the finish, and inspect the submodel's exposed connectors. Its free antistud must remain available after internal connections are made.
Place the rail in the parent. Select a world connector on the placed rail and use the module's local antistud as the source. The same module can be used again with a different pose.
Validate the whole assembly after docking. Check flattened leaves for support and interference between modules, and verify the separate placements in your requested count and orientation.
expected: Two copies of the same local panel connect to one rail. Five flattened parts are valid and connected, and each module has its own pose.
